description: This file defines the factory class RegistrationEventProcessorFactory, which creates instances of registration event processors based on the provided event type. It includes logic to handle specific event types related to employee counts and throws an exception for invalid types.

classes.name: RegistrationEventProcessorFactory
classes.description: Factory class that returns the appropriate registration event processor based on event type input.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventProcessor
methods.description: Creates and returns an appropriate AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor based on the provided event type string.
